justin was a baller today, he did a great job keeping his head on a swivel and helping out wherever needed! i also think he did a better job not getting distracted today

alyssa was coached several times today. she came into her shift 1.5 hours early and kept trying to stand in the front, chat, and eat her food and i had to tell her 3 times to stay in the back and not help out because she isn’t on shift. when she was on window there was difficulty because she kept trying to retrieve drinks, stock, and run drinks out. i coached her on everything in the moment. she asked to switch spots with justin, and i asked her to stay where she was. i heard her mention to sofia a a few comments complaining about being on window. when nolan came on a SL and wrote rotation she walked past me and said “finally, i haven’t gotten to make a drink all day” i was originally nervous to have a post shift chat with her because sometimes she can have a weird tone but after hearing that last comment from her i decided that i needed to. 

i discussed with her how i felt like i had to coach her on several things and i just wanted to check in with her about them. i explained how we are really pushing the importance of being present on window and even though i really appreciate everything she does to help out i wanted her to focus on putting that energy into the conversation she could be having. i emphasized that we have a lot of newbies and i don’t want them to see her walking away from window to retrieve drinks (when im not flexing) and running drinks out because they are sponges and will see that and then do it. i also mentioned that i felt concerned that she was grumpy with me for coaching her especially because i overheard her comment about not getting to make a drink all day. i told her that i'm just here to help and want her to succeed, i’m not trying to target her. when she told me she didn’t mean it that was i explained how even if she didn’t mean it that way, it did come off that way. she apologized, thanked me for helping her and being straight forward, and gave me a hug. 

ps-i felt proud of myself for having that post shift with her and getting a positive response from it🤪

Xbro was good, but one thing I feel like I’m struggling with is trying to set up drinks for the bars. Like a lot of the time I’ll set up drinks and I’m having a hard time finding out how to communicate that. I understand I could openly call out when I have a drink grabbed, but I feel from personal experience on bar, that distracts them from the drink they are making. Also I try to keep an eye out on the bars so I can see when they have claimed the drink so I bring it to them, but I feel like I can’t just stand there watching the bars, sometimes I’ll get pulled away to walk up, or window, so the drinks will just sit there. I think perhaps I just need to practice this more but I wonder if there is some other way to be able to communicate or refine this to prevent the occasional waste of product. Other than that though it went well and I still think it’s very helpful for being a flexible window/walkup/GSD position based on what’s needed.
